verdict.rationale: Postmark is a SaaS email service that could plausibly ship in-product AI insights, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only raw delivery, open, and click statistics (Stats API) and a community mention of an official MCP server for external agents. Neither is an in-product AI-generated insight or suggestion feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
